Class SpillWriter

java.lang.Object
org.roux.spill.SpillWriter
@Component public class SpillWriter extends Object
The SpillWriter writes one page to its own file. The file is {dir}/{regionId}/{pageId}.pg. RegionPack is the writer that uses one pages.bin instead. This writer still emits one file per page id when a caller uses it. The checksum is written before the bytes are copied. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SpillWriter roux-design.md

  • Method Details

    • isEnabled

      public boolean isEnabled()
      The method reports whether spill is enabled. A missing spill block returns false.
      Returns:
      The flag is true when spill is enabled.

    • regionDir

      public Path regionDir(String regionId)
      The method returns the directory for one region. A missing directory setting uses the user home plus /.casserole/roux.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name under that directory.
      Returns:
      The path is the region directory.

    • write

      public Path write(String regionId, Page page) throws IOException
      The method writes the used bytes of one page. The checksum is written first. The file is created or truncated. The channel is forced before it is closed.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
      page - The page is the hot page to write.
      Returns:
      The path is the file that was written.
      Throws:
      IOException - The write failed.

    • read

      public byte[] read(Path file, int offset, int length) throws IOException
      The method copies bytes from a spill file onto the heap. A short file leaves the unread tail as zeros.
      Parameters:
      file - The file is the spill file.
      offset - The offset is the first byte to read.
      length - The length is the number of bytes to copy.
      Returns:
      The array is the heap copy.
      Throws:
      IOException - The read failed.

    • deleteRegion

      public void deleteRegion(String regionId)
      The method deletes the files in a region's spill directory and then deletes the directory. A missing directory returns without an error. An input-output error is ignored.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
